maestrly-bot.note: Your own chats on your own desktop. This endpoint is served by Maestrly Desktop itself, so replace the host with the public address that person configured in Settings > Bots; it must be reachable over HTTPS from wherever this bot runs, and it answers only while their application is running. Authorization is OAuth with PKCE: the client discovers the authorization server at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp/bots, the owner approves the request on their desktop, and no secret belongs in this file.

maestrly.note: Delegated development inside a project of an organization, served by a Maestrly server. Separate connection, separate grant, separate token audience. Discovery lives at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp. Keep only the endpoint you were granted.
